name: AI Startup Funding in May 2026: 37 Deals, $25B Disclosed
snippet: Eighty-two venture capital rounds closed or were announced across May, with AI startups capturing 37 deals—nearly 45 percent of all activity. Publicly disclosed funding for AI companies alone reached $25 billion, driven by a handful of mega-deals and a steady stream of mid-market rounds. The velocity is real.

name: Q1 2026 VC Funding Hits Record $297B, AI Claims 81%
snippet: Q1 2026 venture investment reached $297 billion globally, an all-time record and a 150% increase year over year, according to Crunchbase’s quarterly report. AI startups captured $239 billion, or 81% of all global VC funding, up from 55% in Q1 2025.
